text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: …Tch. Pathetic. That was such a sluggish run…

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: I'm fine! You just worry about your own job!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Damn, I'm so weak! Weak! I shouldn't be worn out already.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Run harder… harder. I've got to run harder!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Unable to get results due to fatigue, Narita Brian has become more impatient and irritated than usual… This isn't good.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: We shouldn't push it any harder. I should probably rethink her race schedule…
